summary: Digital Currency X Technology Inc., a Cayman Islands foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting of a 160-for-1 share consolidation, an authorized share capital increase from US$300,000 to US$48,000,000, and related changes. These routine capital-structure adjustments—aimed at reducing share count and potentially regaining Nasdaq compliance—are not a special situation. The registrant acted as issuer; no third-party transaction, premium, or strategic event occurred. No 'what-to-watch' or risk-arb angle applies.
